endpoints.name: submissions
endpoints.description: A company's filing history and metadata (name, tickers, exchanges). cik is the 10-digit CIK with leading zeros.

endpoints.name: company_concept
endpoints.description: All XBRL disclosures of one company for one concept, for example us-gaap / AccountsPayableCurrent. Small and focused: prefer this over company_facts.

endpoints.name: company_facts
endpoints.description: Every XBRL concept for one company in one file. Can be several MB for large companies; Titan refuses responses over 5 MB, so use company_concept when you know the concept.

endpoints.name: frames
endpoints.description: One fact per reporting company for a calendar period, for comparing companies. period is CY2019, CY2019Q1 or CY2019Q1I (instantaneous).

params.name: unit
params.description: Unit of measure, for example USD or USD-per-shares
